summary: A labelled input, in three sizes, three shapes and three shadows, with an optional icon and error or success states.

props.name: label
props.description: Text above the control. `Field.Root` and `Field.Label` associate it automatically, so no `id`/`htmlFor` bookkeeping is needed.

props.name: required
props.description: Appends a red asterisk to the label & sets the control's native `required` attribute.

props.name: description
props.description: A line under the control, for format or context. Replaced by `error` or `success` when either is set.

props.name: error
props.description: Red border, a warning icon & this message in place of `description`. Wins over `success` if both are set.

props.name: success
props.description: Green border, a check icon & this message in place of `description`.

props.name: size
props.description: Height and width of the control.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius. `squircle` uses `corner-shape`, which degrades to a rounded square where that is unsupported.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Depth on the control. `inset` reads as a well, `outset` as a raised control.

props.name: icon
props.description: Any icon. It is positioned over the control, so pass the glyph and nothing else. Hidden once `error` or `success` is set, which claim the trailing slot for their own icon.

props.name: iconInteractive
props.description: Lets `icon` receive pointer events, for an inline button - a clear or reveal toggle - instead of a decorative glyph.

props.name: prefixNode
props.description: Static content flush against the control's leading edge, like a URL scheme. Mutually exclusive with `icon`/`suffix` in practice - each claims the same row.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Static content flush against the control's trailing edge, like a domain suffix.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction and dims the whole field, label included.

props.name: type
props.description: Native input type. For a password field with a visibility toggle, see the Password recipe rather than `type="password"` here.

props.name: revealable
props.description: Adds a trailing button that shows and hides the value, for password fields. Always trailing and always interactive, so it overrides `iconPosition` and `icon`.
